commands.review_summary:
The PR broadens Deep Research placeholder detection in `sessionDisplay` to treat captures that start with tool-call markers as recoverable and adds focused sessionDisplay tests.

Reproducibility: yes. by source inspection: a log that starts with the multiline `Called tool / Deep Research App` wrapper and later appends `[auto-reattach] ... Answer:` still feeds the first answer to the new `startsWith` predicate. I did not run a live Pro browser session in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(cli): recover Deep Research App tool-call wrapper captures via reattach
target.body:
## Problem

`isDeepResearchPlaceholderCapture` (`src/cli/sessionDisplay.ts`) only treated a capture as a recoverable placeholder when the normalized answer *exactly* equaled `"called tool"` / `"used tool"` (plus two Polish variants) **and** `outputTokens <= 8`:

```ts
const isToolOnly =
  answer === "called tool" || answer === "used tool" || ...;
return isToolOnly && (outputTokens == null || outputTokens <= 8);
```

ChatGPT's "Deep Research App" connector (issue #297) saves a multi-line tool-call wrapper in place of the report:

```
Called tool
Deep Research App
Call tool
Request { ... }
Response { session_id: ... }
```

That text starts with a tool-call marker but is ~23 lines, so it fails the exact-equality check and exceeds the `outputTokens <= 8` gate. `canReattach` never fires, and `oracle session <id> --render` replays the stale wrapper instead of triggering the OOPIF reattach that recovers the full report. The reporter confirmed the reattach path itself works (it recovered the complete 33,918-char report from the sandbox iframe) - only the trigger was too narrow.

## Fix

Detect the placeholder structurally: any capture whose normalized answer *begins with* a tool-call marker. This subsumes the bare stub and catches the multi-line wrapper regardless of length. The function is only reached for deep-research browser sessions with fallback session info (see the `isDeepResearchBrowserSession(metadata) && hasFallbackSessionInfo` guard at the call site), so a real report - which never starts with a tool-call marker - is not affected; a rare false positive would only trigger a non-destructive reattach.

## Tests

Exported the predicate (following the existing `trimBeforeFirstAnswer` test-export precedent) and added regression coverage:
- bare tool-only stub -> placeholder
- multi-line Deep Research App wrapper -> placeholder (fails before this change, passes after)
- Polish marker -> placeholder
- a real report answer -> not a placeholder (no false positive)

`vitest run tests/cli/sessionDisplay.test.ts`: 33 passed. `tsc --noEmit` and `oxlint` clean.

Fixes #297
